dispositions.rationale: witnessSetRoot == 0 is an explicit existence sentinel. grant() rejects EmptyWitnessRoot before storage, so a valid grant cannot collide with the sentinel.
grant() intentionally reads only headSequence; transitionId and stateRoot are unrelated to range bounds.
_controllerOf() intentionally reads only controller from the Registry authorization tuple.
The detector traces the Grant struct that also contains timestamps, but the reported comparison is against witnessSetRoot and does not depend on block.timestamp.
The bounded assembly reads r, s, and v from a signature whose length was checked as exactly 65 bytes. Low-s and non-zero signer checks follow.
STATICCALL is required for ERC-1271. The result must succeed, contain at least 32 bytes, and decode to the exact magic value before authorization.
